title: Illustrative checkout deadline allocation
method: A 400 ms total deadline is allocated as 250 + 80 + 70 ms. This is a planning budget, not a sum of measured percentiles. Two 80 ms attempts exceed the 150 ms remaining after existing work, before retry backoff.
alt: Illustrative checkout deadline allocation. Existing work: 250 ms; Pricing allowance: 80 ms; Unallocated margin: 70 ms. Illustrative inputs.
